// Volatility Coil Release - Loaded vs Predictable 3D
// ATR: Wilder RMA via atr() — validated vs TradingView
// Coil: ATR/range compression vs highest lookback — 0 expanded, 1 coiled
// Vol-of-vol: stdev/sma ratio rising vs lowest base

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 100, 1)
volVolLen = input(20, "Vol of Vol Length", 5, 50, 1)
volVolBase = input(50, "Vol of Vol Base", 10, 100, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 50, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.5, 0.95, 0.05)
predictThresh = input(0.35, "Predict Threshold", 0.1, 0.8, 0.05)
releaseATRMult = input(1.05, "Release ATR Mult", 1.0, 2.0, 0.05)
releaseRangeMult = input(1.8, "Release Range Mult", 1.2, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
rngHigh = highest(rng, coilLookback)
atrCompress = atrVal / max(atrHigh, 0.000000001)
rngCompress = rng / max(rngHigh, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 1 - (atrCompress + rngCompress) / 2
atrAvg = sma(atrVal, volVolLen)
volVolRaw = stdev(atrVal, volVolLen) / max(atrAvg, 0.000000001)
volVolLow = lowest(volVolRaw, volVolBase)
volVolRising = volVolRaw / max(volVolLow, 0.000000001)
sumR = sma(rng, predictLen) * predictLen
netMove = abs(close - close[predictLen])
predictVal = netMove / max(sumR, 0.000000001)
rngLow = lowest(rng, coilLookback)
releaseEnergy = (rng / max(rngLow, 0.000000001)) * (atrVal / max(atrVal[1], 0.000000001))
loaded = coilLoad > coilThresh
predictable = predictVal > predictThresh
rising = volVolRising > 1.2
buySig = coilLoad[1] > coilThresh and volVolRising > 1.2 and rng > rng[1] * releaseRangeMult and atrVal > atrVal[1] * releaseATRMult and close > open
sellSig = coilLoad[1] > coilThresh and volVolRising > 1.2 and rng > rng[1] * releaseRangeMult and atrVal > atrVal[1] * releaseATRMult and close < open
if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Release Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Release Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if buySig { barcolor("#22cc88") }
if sellSig { barcolor("#ff4477") }
if loaded { bgcolor("#22aaff") }
plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictVal, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot(volVolRising, "VolVol Rising", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictVal, "Predictability 3D", "line3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)
plot3d(releaseEnergy, "Release Energy 3D", "scatter", "#ff6b35", "separate", 2)

sessBars = input(20, "SessionBars", 10, 100, 1)
structLb = input(3, "StructureLookback", 1, 10, 1)
minDisp = input(0.15, "MinDisplacementPct", 0.01, 2.0, 0.01)
confThresh = input(60, "ConfidenceThreshold", 0, 100, 1)
stopTicks = input(5, "StopOffsetTicks", 1, 50, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessBars)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessBars)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHighSrc = security("1h", high)
htfLowSrc = security("1h", low)
htfRange = htfHighSrc - htfLowSrc

prevHTFHigh = highest(htfHighSrc, structLb)
prevHTFLow = lowest(htfLowSrc, structLb)
prevHTFHighPrev = prevHTFHigh[1]
prevHTFLowPrev = prevHTFLow[1]

avgLen = structLb * 5
avgRange = sma(htfRange, avgLen)
rawQuality = avgRange > 0 ? (htfRange - avgRange) / avgRange * 100 : 0
qualityClip = rawQuality < 0 ? 0 : rawQuality > 100 ? 100 : rawQuality
confidence = 50 + qualityClip / 2
confidenceCap = confidence > 100 ? 100 : confidence
conf01 = confidenceCap / 100

dispBull = prevHTFHighPrev > 0 ? (htfClose - prevHTFHighPrev) / prevHTFHighPrev * 100 : 0
dispBear = prevHTFLowPrev > 0 ? (prevHTFLowPrev - htfClose) / prevHTFLowPrev * 100 : 0
bullAgree = htfClose > prevHTFHighPrev and dispBull >= minDisp
bearAgree = htfClose < prevHTFLowPrev and dispBear >= minDisp

ticksize = close * 0.0001
hardStopLong = sessLow - stopTicks * ticksize
hardStopShort = sessHigh + stopTicks * ticksize
stopPctLong = close > 0 ? (close - hardStopLong) / close * 100 : 1
stopPctShort = close > 0 ? (hardStopShort - close) / close * 100 : 1
stopPctLongFix = stopPctLong <= 0 ? 0.1 : stopPctLong
stopPctShortFix = stopPctShort <= 0 ? 0.1 : stopPctShort

buySig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullAgree and confidenceCap >= confThresh
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearAgree and confidenceCap >= confThresh
buyExitSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) or low <= hardStopLong
sellExitSig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) or high >= hardStopShort

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopPctLongFix)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    alert("Siege Long Confidence")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopPctShortFix)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    alert("Siege Short Confidence")
}
if buyExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "x", "#ffcc00")
    alert("Siege Exit Long Confidence")
}
if sellExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "x", "#ffcc00")
    alert("Siege Exit Short Confidence")
}
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
volLen = input(14, "Volatility Length", 5, 30, 1)
breakLen = input(20, "Breakout Length", 5, 50, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volatility Multiplier", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

mom = close - close[momLen]
curRange = high - low
priorMax = highest(curRange[1], volLen)
volExpandA = curRange > volMult * priorMax
volExpandB = curRange > priorMax
volExpand = volExpandA or volExpandB
breakHigh = highest(high[1], breakLen)
breakLow = lowest(low[1], breakLen)
buyCond = close > breakHigh and mom > 0 and volExpand
sellCond = close < breakLow and mom < 0 and volExpand
buySig = buyCond and not buyCond[1]
sellSig = sellCond and not sellCond[1]
pendingWatch = volExpand and not buyCond and not sellCond

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}
if pendingWatch {
  bgcolor("#ffee8833")
}

plot(breakHigh, "Breakout High", "#22cc88", 1)
plot(breakLow, "Breakout Low", "#ff4477", 1)
fill(breakHigh, breakLow, "#8888ff33")
plot(mom, "Momentum", "#3399ff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#808080", "separate")
plot3d(breakHigh, "3D Break High", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(breakLow, "3D Break Low", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)
plot3d(mom, "3D Momentum", "ribbon", "#3399ff", "separate", 0)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

hh = highest(high, lookback)
ll = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = hh - ll
L236 = ll + rng * f236
L382 = ll + rng * f382
L50 = ll + rng * f50
L618 = ll + rng * f618

buySig = close[1] <= L618[1] and close > L618
sellSig = close[1] >= L382[1] and close < L382

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, L618, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvent")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, L382, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvent")
}

plot(L236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(L382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(L50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(L618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(L236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(L382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(L50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(L618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Horizon", 2, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Horizon", 5, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Horizon", 10, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "Skew Range Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
compThresh = input(0.70, "Compression Ratio Threshold", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
expMult = input(1.15, "Expansion Multiplier", 1.01, 2.0, 0.01)
bullLvl = input(0.55, "Bullish Skew Flip Level", 0.51, 0.9, 0.01)
bearLvl = input(0.45, "Bearish Skew Flip Level", 0.1, 0.49, 0.01)
annFac = input(365, "Annualization Factor", 1, 365, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
annRoot = sqrt(annFac)
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * annRoot
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * annRoot
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * annRoot
avgVol = (fastVol + medVol + slowVol) / 3.0
rngHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
rngLow = lowest(low, skewLen)
rngSpan = rngHigh - rngLow + 0.000000001
skewRaw = (close - rngLow) / rngSpan
skewHi = skewRaw > 1.0
skewLo = skewRaw < 0.0
skew = skewHi ? 1.0 : skewLo ? 0.0 : skewRaw
cSkew = skew - 0.5
spreadFM = fastVol - medVol
spreadFS = fastVol - slowVol
spreadMS = medVol - slowVol
denomVol = max(medVol, slowVol) + 0.000000001
compRatio = fastVol / denomVol
compressed = compRatio < compThresh
fastPrev = fastVol[1]
compPrev = compressed[1]
expanded = compPrev and fastVol > fastPrev * expMult and fastVol > medVol
bullFlip = skew > bullLvl and skew[1] <= bullLvl
bearFlip = skew < bearLvl and skew[1] >= bearLvl
buyRaw = expanded and bullFlip
sellRaw = expanded and bearFlip
bullLine = bullLvl + (close - close[1]) * 0.0001
bearLine = bearLvl + (close - close[1]) * 0.0001
impulseVol = fastVol * (0.8 + 0.4 * skew)

var armed = 1.0
buySig = buyRaw and armed[1] > 0.5
sellSig = sellRaw and armed[1] > 0.5
if compressed {
  armed := 1.0
}
if buySig or sellSig {
  armed := 0.0
}

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

bgcolor(compressed ? "#1a2a4a" : "#00000000")
plot(spreadFS, "Spread F-S", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(bullLine, "Bull Flip", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(bearLine, "Bear Flip", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(avgVol, "Term Surface", "manifold", "#8a5cff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(impulseVol, "Skew Impulse", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(50, "Ch5 dBm", 0, 100, 1)
maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 1, 200, 1)
thicknessBase = input(1, "Thickness Base", 0.5, 5, 0.5)
thicknessFactor = input(0.05, "Thickness Factor", 0, 0.2, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rng = (high - low) + 0.000001
m1 = (close - open) / (close + 0.000001) * 400
m2 = (high - low) / (close + 0.000001) * 200 - 10
m3 = (close - low) / rng * 30 - 15
m4 = (high - close) / rng * 30 - 15
m5 = (close - close[1]) / (close + 0.000001) * 400
d1 = max(0, min(100, ch1 + m1))
d2 = max(0, min(100, ch2 + m2))
d3 = max(0, min(100, ch3 + m3))
d4 = max(0, min(100, ch4 + m4))
d5 = max(0, min(100, ch5 + m5))
h1 = d1 / maxScale * 100
h2 = d2 / maxScale * 100
h3 = d3 / maxScale * 100
h4 = d4 / maxScale * 100
h5 = d5 / maxScale * 100
avgV = (d1 + d2 + d3 + d4 + d5) / 5
W = thicknessBase + thicknessFactor * avgV
avgPrev = avgV[1]
buySig = avgPrev <= 70 and avgV > 70 and h5 > h1
sellSig = avgPrev >= 30 and avgV < 30 and h5 < h1

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

plot(h1, "H1", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot(h2, "H2", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(h3, "H3", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(h4, "H4", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(h5, "H5", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(avgV, "Spline AVG", "#33ccff", W, "separate")
plot3d(h1, "Cell Cyl 1", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 10)
plot3d(h2, "Cell Cyl 2", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 11)
plot3d(h3, "Cell Cyl 3", "bars3d", "#ffcc33", "separate", 12)
plot3d(h4, "Cell Cyl 4", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 13)
plot3d(h5, "Cell Cyl 5", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 14)
plot3d(avgV, "Cell Spline Tops", "ribbon", "#33ccff", "separate", 15)

wx = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wy = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wz = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windBase = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpd = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
maxSpd = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
maxStretch = input(5.0, "Max Stretch Factor", 1.0, 10.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) / (abs(close) + 0.000000001) * 20.0
gust = sin(bar_index / 12.0) * 5.0
windDyn = windBase + drift + gust

dx = wx + (close - open) / (abs(close) + 0.000000001) * 2.0
dy = wy + (high - low) / (abs(close) + 0.000000001) * 1.0
dz = wz + (close - close[1]) / (abs(close) + 0.000000001) * 2.0

mag = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) + 0.000000001
nx = dx / mag
ny = dy / mag
nzRaw = dz / mag
nzC = nzRaw < -1.0 ? -1.0 : nzRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : nzRaw

yawRad = atan2(ny, nx)
pitchRad = asin(nzC)
rollRad = atan2(ny, nx)
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = rollRad * 57.29578

span = (maxSpd - minSpd) + 0.000000001
sNormRaw = (windDyn - minSpd) / span
sNorm = sNormRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : sNormRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : sNormRaw

tailLen = baseTail * (1.0 + sNorm * (maxStretch - 1.0))
arrowColor = sNorm > 0.66 ? "#ff8800" : sNorm > 0.33 ? "#9955ff" : "#2266ff"
coneRaw = tailLen * markerSize
coneSize = coneRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : coneRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : coneRaw

highThresh = 0.8 * maxSpd
lowThresh = 0.2 * maxSpd
buySig = crossover(windDyn, highThresh) and nx > 0.0
sellSig = crossover(windDyn, highThresh) and nx < 0.0
calmSig = crossunder(windDyn, lowThresh)

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Tailwind", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Headwind", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if calmSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "diamond", "#2266ff")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Tailwind", "coneup", arrowColor, coneSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Headwind", "conedown", arrowColor, coneSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Calm", "diamond", arrowColor, coneSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}

plot(windDyn, "Wind Speed Knots", "#2266ff", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")
plot3d(windDyn, "Wind Speed", "trail", "#2266ff", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#ff8800", "separate", 1)
